name: Night’s Ember
body:
School evocation [fire]; Level bloodrager 2, magus 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a piece of coal)

EFFECT

Range 60 feet
Area 60-foot-radius emanation
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You hold up the coal which alights in a soft orange light.

This light does not burn your hand, however any creature in the radius with the shadow subtype or currently in an area of dim light or darker is covered is a nimbus of orange flame, glowing like a candle as per the spell faerie fire. Additionally at the beginning of their turn, an affected creature must make a Fortitude save or take 1 fire damage. A successful saving throw negates damage but not the highlighting. This fire can target incorporeal creatures.
